Do not repeat the stream-bank panorama, river on the right, opposite-bank log, mountains or framing trunks unless this specific story idea calls for them. Match the same forest world through felt texture, natural vegetation, palette and light, not background layout. Show only Milo as the animal subject. Keep mouth closed, no visible teeth, no clothes or accessories. Show grounded support/contact appropriate to the pose. Target time/light: afternoon. No text, subtitles, labels or watermark.
